original_four_hour.verdict: workload passed; head host-memory growth needs follow-up
interpretation: The four-hour workload and correctness checks passed.
Retained states and snapshot bytes match across quiet endpoints; resident graph count grew from 141 to its configured limit of 144.
Grammar-cache warm-up accounts for an observed category of head memory growth, but does not establish allocation-level attribution.
Head anonymous-plus-swap memory continued growing after grammar-cache size was nearly flat; this is not a leak-free endurance finding.
Worker anonymous-plus-swap change was small. No sampled OOM, memory-floor, health, or progress failure occurred.
Container anonymous memory plus swap is a host-memory indicator, not total model or GPU memory.

accounting.primary_process_indicator: Sum of RssAnon + VmSwap over the rank processes, from the preserved /proc snapshots.
accounting.cgroup_indicator: memory.stat anon + memory.swap.current includes additional swap charges; it is not a count of live allocator bytes.
accounting.limitation: Swap-cache counters were sampled after the campaign, not at both quiet endpoints; no retroactive swap-cache subtraction is claimed.

isolated_cpu_control.scope: Disposable CPU-only container; no GPU or serving-process trim. Compare anonymous memory plus swap, not RSS alone.

protocol.warmup: One unscored wave per shape, 32 output tokens at C1 and 64 at C32
protocol.order: Temperature, task, concurrency; warmup then one scored repetition
protocol.c32_rate: health-counter output tokens / eligible full-occupancy decode seconds
protocol.end_to_end: all output tokens / earliest request start to latest response end
protocol.cache_scope: Warm per shape; no cold-prefix claim

performance.scope: One scored repetition per shape plus warmup, compared with the earlier three-run median; not a replacement hero benchmark.

limits: Targeted finite regression after the original four-hour run; a second four-hour or 24-hour run was not performed.
Allocator retention is an established contributor, not proof that every future memory-growth source is eliminated.
glibc counters exclude Zig page allocations, CUDA/device allocations and other mappings; free arenas may contain discarded pages.
